## Get the course files {#files}

[vibing.jonasmoss.com]{style="font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: 800; color: #f0674d;"}

- Click **Strategy and Entrepreneurship**. The **handout** is there, and **Course files** downloads it
  with the practice folders as one zip.
- Every prompt from both days is in the handout, with a copy button, including
  what we don't get to. So are all the slides.
- Thursday, and the start of Friday, are for everyone, in order. The coral blocks
  work in any order: we pick them together.

## Before we talk: start the install {#start}

1. Click **Start**, type `powershell`, open **Windows PowerShell** (not the "x86" one).
2. Paste the lines for your tool, press Enter, and leave it running (lid open).

```powershell
# Claude subscription (both lines):
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("Path", [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","User") + ";$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin", "User")
# ChatGPT subscription:
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1 | iex"
```

Mac: handout, section 1. It downloads while we talk.
